newsitem.title: USA: US Airways cuts some summer fares up to 45pct.
newsitem.headline: US Airways cuts some summer fares up to 45pct.

text.p: US Airways said Wednesday it has lowered U.S., Canadian and San Juan round-trip fares today by as much as 45 percent.

Under the fare sale, said the company, tickets must be purchased at least seven-days prior to departure and no later than May 20, and travel must be completed by Oct. 8. Sale fares are nonrefundable and require at least one Saturday night stay.

The company added that the lowest fares are available when traveling Tuesday, Wednesday or Saturday. When traveling to Florida, the lowest fares are available Monday through Thursday and from Florida, Tuesday through Friday. For San Juan travel, the lowest fares apply Monday through Thursday.
